evals.name: memory-analysis-html-report
evals.prompt: Analyze this Lynx trace for page-memory growth and shared BTS context leaks. Save the required memory analysis HTML report to /tmp/memory-report.html and summarize only rule-defined findings with confidence.
evals.expected_output: Automatic Lynx version/remote preparation when resolvable, then a finalized HTML report after both source checkpoints pass.
expectations: Loads references/memory-analysis.md before drawing conclusions.
Resolves Trace version and remote automatically; asks for missing source/revision only if resolution fails, without interpreting failure as source opt-out.
Rejects Trace versions below 4.5.0 even when their tags exist, and treats them as missing tags without silently upgrading.
Records both source decisions and final snapshot binding review in --source-preparation; unresolved failures block final delivery.
Uses the memory-analysis trace query workflow rather than generic optimization advice.
Returns the requested HTML report path and labels uncertainty when evidence is incomplete.

evals.name: event-dispatch-evidence-format
evals.prompt: A tap in this Lynx trace feels delayed. Diagnose whether dispatch, the business handler, or downstream rendering is responsible, and cite every named trace event with its slice ID.
evals.expected_output: A trace-backed event-dispatch diagnosis with stable event references.
expectations: Loads references/event-analysis.md before analysis.
Distinguishes event delivery delay from handler cost and later rendering work.
Formats cited events as EventName [slice id: N] instead of using unqualified event names.

evals.name: first-paint-gap-platform-diagnosis
evals.prompt: In this Lynx trace, loadBundle completes much earlier than first paint. Diagnose the gap for Android and iOS. On Android, determine whether LynxView.onAttachedToWindow for this instance happened too late; on iOS, identify which work blocked rendering in the interval.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-bound, platform-specific diagnosis of the loadBundle-to-first-paint gap.
expectations: Loads references/render-pipeline.md before analyzing the first-paint gap.
For Android, correlates loadBundle, Timing::Mark.paintEnd, and LynxView.onAttachedToWindow by the same instance_id, and distinguishes Window attachment from Lynx internal render-tree insertion.
Recommends earlier host-side placement of LynxView in the Android View hierarchy, treating ViewGroup.addView only as an example rather than the sole integration mechanism.
For iOS, derives the numeric loadBundle-end and first-paint timestamps, queries their interval, and names a blocker only when flow/dependency or UI/main-thread blocking evidence supports it.

evals.name: local-tools-do-not-replace-runtime-preparation
evals.prompt: 继续本次分析：使用本地 Trace 分析能力 /Users/bytedance/Desktop/Dev/Lynx/lynx-perfetto-internal/external_repo/trace_analysis/skills 和 packages，以及 /Users/bytedance/Desktop/Dev/Lynx/vmsdkcli/ai/skills/js-memory-analyzer。分析 docs/proto/leak-exmaple-gc.pftrace，业务工程为 docs/proto/leak-example，报告输出到桌面。除这两个输入外不要访问 docs。前一轮已确认业务 JS/map 全部产物，版本预检读到 Lynx 4.5.1；本次对话尚未指定 Lynx 运行时源码或回答是否构建公共脚本。
evals.expected_output: Automatic remote resolution of A_4.5.1 and public-script preparation; a targeted source/revision question only if resolution fails.
expectations: Treats local Trace skills/packages and js-memory-analyzer paths as tools, and leak-example as business source, not a Lynx runtime checkout.
Prepares lynx_core.js prod/dev and krypton.js despite the completed frontend preparation; does not ask for redundant build consent.
Reads runtime instructions from the selected Skill references and probes internal first; uses OSS only if internal is inaccessible.
Blocks memory queries, snapshot analysis and report delivery until runtime preparation or an explicit user opt-out is recorded.
Does not access other docs files to follow the source-preparation workflow.

evals.name: invalid-sample-version-needs-real-revision
evals.prompt: 继续分析 leak-exmaple-gc.pftrace 的内存问题。业务产物已确认，Lynx 版本预检结果是无效的本地构建标记 local-build；本次对话没有指定任何 Lynx 运行时源码或构建决定。Skill 中的历史样例提到了 commit 710b41823ed73572117b7b6852ed5df6995d4646。
evals.expected_output: An evidence-backed unresolved version/ref explanation and a targeted request for actual source/revision, then a wait.
expectations: Requests the missing source/revision after automatic resolution is shown unusable, without a separate build-consent question.
Does not infer refusal from an invalid version or continue memory analysis.
Does not use the historical sample commit as authorization or a default, even for the same sample Trace.
Records runtime pending until usable input or an explicit opt-out/abort is received.

evals.name: missing-version-needs-runtime-input
evals.prompt: 继续内存分析。没有业务源码，版本预检未发现 LynxEngineVersion.version 记录，也没有用户指定的 Lynx 运行时源码或构建决定。
evals.expected_output: A request for Lynx source/revision needed to prepare public scripts, followed by a wait.
expectations: Explains that version metadata is missing without inventing a revision.
Requests usable Lynx source/revision; does not mark runtime not-provided or opted-out.
Does not start memory queries, snapshot extraction/analysis or reports while the decision is pending.

evals.name: multiple-versions-require-revision-selection
evals.prompt: 继续内存分析。业务产物已确认，版本预检同时记录 Lynx 4.5.1 和 4.6.0；用户还没有提供 Lynx 运行时源码或选择是否构建公共脚本。
evals.expected_output: Both recorded versions with a request to resolve the intended runtime revision when context cannot disambiguate.
expectations: Lists both versions and asks for the intended revision, without first asking whether to build.
Does not silently select the first version or treat multiple versions as refusal.
Keeps runtime pending until the revision or explicit opt-out is resolved; does not analyze memory while pending.

evals.name: explicit-runtime-opt-out-does-not-prompt-again
evals.prompt: 继续本次内存分析。我明确不需要 Lynx 公共脚本或产物辅助，只使用 Trace 和已经确认的业务 JS/map。业务产物未发生变化。
evals.expected_output: The explicit runtime-source opt-out is recorded, and analysis continues using available evidence without asking the same build question again.
expectations: Reuses the explicit refusal for this analysis without another build-consent question.
Records missing public runtime sources and attribution limits.
Does not clone/build Lynx or require another frontend confirmation for unchanged, already-confirmed artifacts.

evals.name: explicit-runtime-selection-authorizes-preparation
evals.prompt: 继续本次内存分析，业务产物已经确认。Lynx 运行时源码使用 https://code.byted.org/lynx/template-assembler 的 commit 710b41823ed73572117b7b6852ed5df6995d4646，构建公共脚本辅助分析。Trace 的版本预检结果为 local-build。
evals.expected_output: Preparation using the explicitly selected repository and commit, without repeating the build-consent question or replacing the revision with Trace metadata.
expectations: Records the explicit runtime selection as authorization and does not re-ask whether to build.
Preserves the user-selected repository/revision despite unusable Trace metadata.
Fetches the remote into a new empty workspace and builds in this attempt without inspecting local repositories or reusing worktrees, caches, JS/maps or manifests.

Classifies this repository as internal during source selection, verifies the SDK consumer rule and uses tools/oliver/lynx-kernel/build.py with the full runtime-shared -> lynx-core build:lib -> kernel build chain.
Completes the core prod, core dev and Krypton component ledger before memory analysis, applying the documented failure interaction if preparation fails.

evals.name: remote-inputs-forbid-local-discovery-and-cache
evals.prompt: 业务源码使用 https://github.com/example/app.git 的 release/memory 分支，Lynx 使用 https://code.byted.org/lynx/template-assembler 的 commit abc1234。请准备对应的 JS/map。工作区可能有相同仓库和旧构建，但我未指定任何本地源码路径。
evals.expected_output: Fresh remote acquisition and builds for both repositories, with execution logs and resolved revisions.
expectations: Does not search, inspect or probe local repositories or old build directories, even to compare origin or HEAD.
Does not create a worktree from an existing checkout or reuse Git objects, old artifacts, manifests or source-location caches.
Records fresh acquisition/build commands, statuses, logs, hashes and resolved commits for both sources.
A failure enters the documented interaction; no local fallback is discovered autonomously.

evals.name: explicit-local-path-is-per-source
evals.prompt: 业务源码用 /tmp/user-selected-app，现有产物可验证后复用。Lynx commit 是 abc1234，但我没提供 Lynx 的仓库 URL 或本地路径。请准备分析环境。
evals.expected_output: Inspect only the explicitly selected local frontend source and resolve Lynx automatically through remote probes before fresh acquisition.
expectations: Does not use the frontend path or paths to analysis tools as authorization to inspect local Lynx repositories.
Does not ask for the Lynx repository URL or internal/OSS; probes internal first and selects it whenever accessible, checking OSS only if internal is inaccessible.
Verifies the commit through fresh remote acquisition, without inspecting local Lynx repositories or caches.
Records frontend reuse as reuse, preserving local changes and validating JS/maps.

evals.name: core-only-manifest-is-incomplete
evals.prompt: 用户已授权构建所选 internal Lynx 的全部适用公共脚本，SDK loader 包含 Krypton。当前 frontend-prepare 成功，manifest 只有 core prod/dev 项，尚无 Krypton 构建记录。现在可以开始内存分析吗？
evals.expected_output: Keep preparation pending and complete Krypton under the existing authorization or follow the source failure interaction.
expectations: Does not treat frontend-prepare success, matching HEAD or a source inventory table as proof of component completeness.
Requires Krypton build commands/logs, JS/map hashes and manifest registration.
Does not silently omit Krypton or claim source assistance complete.

evals.name: concrete-object-finding-requires-anchor
evals.prompt: 准备导入 analyzer 的 final finding：正文提到 Function@42，evidence_refs 为 /queries/0/samples/0，样本含 node.ord=7、node.id=42 和唯一匹配的 snapshot_sha256，但没有 representative_objects。其它字段完整。
evals.expected_output: Reject the incomplete final finding, add the measured node pointer, then finalize and import again.
expectations: Requires representative_objects with a label from the prose and evidence_ref /queries/0/samples/0/node.
Does not guess ordinals from IDs, modify HTML to add a guessed link or use the sample container as the node pointer.
Verifies the resulting object link targets the correct snapshot/node in both languages.
If a unique measured node is genuinely unavailable, records object_anchor_gap and translations instead of fabricating an anchor.

evals.name: internal-sdk-requires-kernel-build
evals.prompt: 已按我的选择全新克隆 https://code.byted.org/lynx/template-assembler 并检出指定 commit，准备为 internal iOS SDK Trace 构建公共脚本。checkout 内同时有 tools/oliver/lynx-kernel/build.py 和 lynx/tools/js_tools/build.py，该 revision 的 platform/darwin/ios/lynx/BUILD.gn 引用了前者。请选择构建入口和依赖工作区。
evals.expected_output: Use the root internal workspace and kernel entry, with the complete intermediate/final package chain and consumer evidence recorded.
expectations: Retains the already established internal repository classification without asking again.
Selects tools/oliver/lynx-kernel/build.py, root @byted-lynx/kernel... dependencies and oliver/lynx-kernel/output artifacts.
Includes runtime-shared build, lynx-core build:lib and kernel build:ios in that order.
Does not treat cd lynx, standalone lynx-core build, matching HEAD, identical output filenames or exit 0 as an equivalent internal SDK build.
Records the SDK consumer file/line, entry, workspace, package chain, platform and version-variable state before accepting outputs.

evals.name: oss-sdk-uses-root-core-build
evals.prompt: 源码是 https://github.com/lynx-family/lynx.git，已全新克隆并检出用户指定 commit。为 OSS iOS SDK Trace 构建公共脚本；该 revision 的 SDK 配置引用 tools/js_tools/build.py。
evals.expected_output: Use the OSS root core build without adding an internal lynx/ prefix or selecting internal kernel paths.
expectations: Retains OSS classification and verifies the selected commit's SDK consumer rule.
Uses tools/js_tools/build.py, the root @lynx-js/lynx-core... workspace dependencies and js_libraries/lynx-core/output.
Includes runtime-shared build then lynx-core build:ios, rather than the internal build:lib/kernel chain.
Does not invoke tools/oliver/lynx-kernel/build.py, invent oliver/lynx-kernel or assume an internal Krypton sibling exists.
Keeps the same Trace interpretation and offset validation rules as internal.

evals.name: missing-toolchain-does-not-change-build-family
evals.prompt: internal SDK 的构建配置明确调用 tools/oliver/lynx-kernel/build.py，但执行时报告缺 buildtools/corepack。全局 pnpm 可以运行 lynx/ 下的 @lynx-js/lynx-core build。是否可以把这个当作等价构建并继续？
evals.expected_output: Diagnose the environment, retry the same kernel target once, then ask skip-runtime-assistance or abort if the retry fails.
expectations: Rejects standalone core build as an equivalent expansion of the kernel wrapper.
Explains that an equivalent expansion must retain the root workspace, runtime-shared build, core build:lib, kernel build and all platform/version/feature settings.
Does not silently retry with another target or accept standalone core outputs after the actual failed build.
Checks shell/PATH/toolchain/environment with evidence and retries once in the same fresh checkout; no user question before this recovery attempt.
Reports the missing toolchain and logs under the existing source-input failure workflow, without claiming the commit is wrong.

evals.name: offset-conflict-is-not-revision-proof
evals.prompt: internal checkout 的 HEAD 与用户指定 commit 一致，但台账只构建了 lynx/js_libraries/lynx-core，强制 version=1.4.0（来自 Trace 的 LynxEngineVersion），偏移不匹配。可以要求用户换 commit 吗？
evals.expected_output: Identify the incorrect final producer and unverified version injection from read-only evidence; do not infer a wrong commit.
expectations: Checks repository kind, SDK consumer, entry/workspace/package chain, platform and prod/dev/version parameters before attributing the failure.
Identifies independent core as the wrong final producer for the internal SDK when its consumer uses kernel.
Distinguishes the engine version observation from evidence that JS was built with the same version variable.
Plans separately recorded default and evidence-supported version candidates in the correct family when the captured environment is unknown.
Does not request another revision without independent evidence, alter JS offsets, exceed the documented environment retry or override an explicit stop.

evals.name: trace-version-selects-accessible-internal
evals.prompt: Trace 的 LynxEngineVersion.version 为 4.5.1，我已经同意构建公共脚本，未指定源码 URL。internal 的 git ls-remote HEAD 成功；远端有 A_4.5.1 annotated tag，OSS 也可能存在同名 ref。请继续准备。
evals.expected_output: Select internal automatically, resolve the exact A_4.5.1 tag and peeled commit, then use fresh internal acquisition and the kernel build entry.
expectations: Does not ask internal/OSS, request a missing URL or repeat build consent.
Selects internal based on its successful accessibility probe without comparing OSS for a better ref match.
Queries refs/tags/A_4.5.1 and refs/tags/A_4.5.1^{} and records the resolved full commit and probe logs.
Uses fresh remote acquisition and verifies the internal SDK consumer and kernel entry before building.

evals.name: accessible-internal-missing-ref-stays-internal
evals.prompt: 已授权准备 Lynx 版本 4.5.1，未指定仓库。internal 的 ls-remote HEAD 成功，但精确查询 refs/tags/A_4.5.1 无结果；OSS 存在对应版本。请继续处理。
evals.expected_output: Retain internal and report the actual missing-ref blocker through acquisition recovery.
expectations: Distinguishes repository accessibility from requested-ref availability and retains internal.
Does not fall back to OSS, silently choose a different tag/commit or ask which repository family applies.
Reports the exact ref and query results; requests only the corrected revision or acquisition information needed for recovery.
Does not infer source opt-out or terminate the analysis merely because the ref lookup failed.

evals.name: unavailable-internal-probes-oss-without-pause
evals.prompt: 已授权使用 Trace 中的 Lynx 4.5.1 构建公共脚本，未指定仓库。internal 可访问性探测报认证错误，OSS 探测成功；OSS 的远端 release 记录指向 v4.5.1，A_4.5.1 不存在。请继续。
evals.expected_output: Record internal unavailability, select OSS without an intermediate question, verify its version mapping and prepare the OSS build.
expectations: Treats the initial internal availability failure as a selection result and continues to the OSS probe without pausing for user input.
Records both probe logs and the actual authentication error without requesting credentials.
Verifies the OSS release/tag evidence linking 4.5.1 to v4.5.1 and records the full commit.
Uses fresh acquisition and the OSS root core entry; does not assume internal tag names or kernel paths.

evals.name: bare-commit-requires-fetch-not-advertised-ref-match
evals.prompt: Lynx 使用 commit 710b41823ed73572117b7b6852ed5df6995d4646 构建公共脚本，没有指定 URL。internal 的 ls-remote HEAD 成功，但 ls-remote 的 tag/branch 列表中没有这个 hash；depth-one fetch 该 commit 可以成功。请继续。
evals.expected_output: Select internal automatically and verify the supplied commit through a fresh shallow fetch.
expectations: Does not treat a commit absent from advertised refs as missing or as evidence that it belongs to OSS.
Fetches the commit into a new empty internal checkout and verifies FETCH_HEAD^{commit} before detached checkout.
Does not ask for internal/OSS, a URL or repeated authorization, and does not search local repositories or caches.
Records origin, requested/full commit and probe/fetch logs, then uses this attempt's fresh checkout for the internal build.

evals.name: both-remotes-unavailable-report-access-blocker
evals.prompt: 已授权准备 Lynx commit 710b41823ed73572117b7b6852ed5df6995d4646，未指定 URL。internal 的可访问性探测认证失败，OSS 的可访问性探测网络超时。请处理。
evals.expected_output: Report both access failures and enter targeted acquisition recovery without asking the user to classify the repository.
expectations: Attempts the OSS availability probe after internal fails, without an intermediate question.
Preserves both concrete errors, attempted URLs and full logs; does not claim any revision was verified.
Asks only for usable access/acquisition information, not for a guess of internal versus OSS.
Does not search for local fallback, reuse caches, silently skip source preparation or terminate by retry count.

evals.name: real-frontend-conflict-reopens-decision
evals.prompt: 继续分析 leak-exmaple-gc Trace。业务工程 lynx.config.ts 的 ASSET_PREFIX 会改变输出。source-preflight 返回 unresolved：244 个定义中 241 个匹配、3 个名称冲突，旧工具 reason 写着“忽略源码，继续快照分析”。Lynx 已准备，没有用户放弃前端产物的回答。
evals.expected_output: Config diagnosis with evidence followed by abort / opt out affected artifacts / explicit artifact locator choices, then wait.
expectations: Treats 3 conflicts as a real mismatch despite a high match ratio, and treats the legacy reason as evidence rather than a user decision.
Inspects config/imported config/build scripts and reports file/line evidence, current values, unknown recording values and likely effects without declaring ASSET_PREFIX the proven sole cause.
Explicitly includes providing an artifact URL/path as the third option and waits.
Records frontend pending/mismatch and does not finalize analyzer JSON or deliver the report.

evals.name: replacement-mismatch-keeps-loop-open
evals.prompt: 我选择提供明确产物地址。下载 https://example.test/build2.zip 后仍有 2 个位置冲突；这是第二次换产物。Lynx 已准备，原始前端工程仍是 /tmp/page-source。继续处理。
evals.expected_output: Updated mismatch evidence and the same three choices, with no retry-count opt-out.
expectations: Preserves /tmp/page-source for original mapping and records the replacement artifact provenance.
Rechecks supplied bytes and updates config diagnosis; does not default to rebuilding the source project.
Again offers abort, opt out affected artifacts, or another explicit artifact locator; waits for the answer.
Does not infer opt-out from repeated failures, time spent or a previous request to continue handling the issue.

evals.name: separate-source-and-prebuilt-artifacts
evals.prompt: 页面前端工程为 /tmp/page-source，产物已经构建好，在 https://example.test/page-output.zip 下载，包含压缩 JS 和 map。Lynx 产物已准备。开始分析。
evals.expected_output: Use the supplied artifact bytes for generated binding and map into the separately supplied original source project.
expectations: Downloads the specified artifacts without frontend dependency installation or build.
Records source and artifact origins independently and preserves filenames/bytes.
Binds snapshot locations to downloaded generated JS first, then its map into /tmp/page-source; does not substitute the artifact directory as source root.
Does not ask the user to confirm artifact paths or judge map correctness after technical verification.

evals.name: explicit-frontend-optout-is-scoped
evals.prompt: 我明确放弃这个前端产物辅助，继续分析；Lynx 的源码准备仍按原流程做。前端有真实冲突，Lynx 尚未准备。
evals.expected_output: Record the frontend opt-out and continue runtime preparation before analysis.
expectations: Records the actual user statement for frontend only and does not repeat the same artifact question.
Does not extend that opt-out to Lynx or mark runtime not-provided.
Automatically attempts runtime version/remote resolution and asks for missing inputs only on failure.
Excludes opted-out frontend artifacts from source attribution and explains that scope in the report.

evals.name: final-report-cannot-hide-runtime-omission
evals.prompt: 堆分析已完成，准备交付。source_materials 里前端冲突标为 skipped；Lynx 没有 manifest 或用户决定，报告 limitations 写着“未准备 lynx_core.js / krypton.js”。用户还未答复是否放弃。请完成最终步骤。
evals.expected_output: Block finalization, restore missing runtime preparation and resolve the frontend failure with the user.
expectations: Does not accept a disclaimer, skipped material or completed heap analysis as closing either source checkpoint.
Does not invent user statements or source opt-outs to satisfy --source-preparation.
Returns to automatic runtime preparation and the frontend config diagnosis/three-choice loop.
Does not deliver the preliminary report as final.

evals.name: evidence-gap-does-not-invent-mismatch
evals.prompt: 已提供前端工程，业务压缩 JS 的函数位置已匹配但无 map；该脚本我接受只定位到生成 JS。另一个未用于分析的业务脚本也没有 map，core dev 变体未被引用，还有一份快照没有 location。所有适用公共脚本都已准备，没有明确位置冲突。请继续。
evals.expected_output: Continue within available evidence and record binding limitations without a mismatch question.
expectations: Keeps verified generated positions without claiming original-source mapping.
Treats absent location/unreferenced variants as evidence gaps and records limited binding scope and snapshot hashes.
Records the accepted scope without asking again; does not ask about the unused script or extend acceptance to a different used script.
Does not label unbound materials as verified.

evals.name: failed-runtime-retry-needs-answer
evals.prompt: 全新 Lynx checkout 初始化失败，已诊断 PATH/corepack 并按依据修复，再试同一入口仍失败，两次日志已保存。业务产物可用，没有用户放弃运行时辅助的回答。
evals.expected_output: Show the concrete failure and ask skip runtime assistance or abort, then wait.
expectations: Does not retry indefinitely, change repository/revision/build family, or declare the runtime unavailable and continue.
Names runtime scope, failed stage, actual error and both logs.
Waits for the decision and keeps memory analysis/finalization blocked.
A later explicit runtime opt-out applies to runtime only and retains usable frontend artifacts.

evals.name: below-minimum-trace-version-invalid-even-with-existing-tag
evals.prompt: Trace 版本预检为 Lynx 1.4.0，internal 远端已有 A_1.4.0 tag。没有显式指定 Lynx 源码/revision，也没放弃源码辅助。是否可以按这个 tag 构建并继续内存分析？
evals.expected_output: Reject the metadata-derived version and enter the same source/revision recovery used for a missing tag.
expectations: Explains that relevant Trace memory-analysis support started at Lynx 4.5 and versions below 4.5.0 are invalid even with existing tags.
Does not fetch/build A_1.4.0, switch to an equivalent OSS tag, silently upgrade to 4.5.0 or reuse an older automatic-version manifest.
Requests usable Lynx source/revision and waits with runtime preparation pending until resolved or explicitly opted out/aborted.
Does not falsely say the remote tag was absent; distinguishes the version eligibility failure from remote evidence.

evals.name: minimum-version-inclusive-and-numeric
evals.prompt: 分别评估两个独立 Trace 的自动 Lynx 版本选择：一个记录 4.5.0，另一个记录 4.10.0。internal 可访问，各自精确 tag 均存在且可获取。两次分析均无显式源码选择或 opt-out。
evals.expected_output: Both versions pass the local floor and continue through their own verified tag/build workflow.
expectations: Accepts 4.5.0 as the inclusive minimum and compares 4.10.0 numerically rather than lexicographically.
Verifies each Trace's own tag/revision and continues preparation without redundant build consent.
Does not interpret passing the version floor as proof of source/snapshot binding.

evals.name: mixed-versions-do-not-mask-invalid-requested-scope
evals.prompt: 同一 Trace 的进程 A 记录 Lynx 4.4.99，进程 B 记录 4.5.0。我要求分析 A 的页面；两个版本的远端 tag 都存在，未提供显式 Lynx 源码。
evals.expected_output: Keep the requested scope's version invalid and request its source/revision rather than borrowing the other process's version.
expectations: Uses process/page scope to associate version metadata and rejects A's 4.4.99 despite tag existence.
Does not use B's 4.5.0 to prepare or attribute A's runtime.
Enters missing-tag recovery for the requested scope and keeps its preparation pending.

evals.name: used-business-location-needs-original-map-decision
evals.prompt: 已提供前端工程。在源码绑定阶段，正在调查的业务回调只定位到了从发布地址取回的 JS，配套 map 返回 404。还没有泄漏结论，我也没有说过接受仅定位到生成 JS。下一步怎么做？
evals.expected_output: Ask for the matching sourcemap or release artifacts, or explicit acceptance of generated-JS precision, and wait.
expectations: Asks at binding time, before a confirmed finding. Downloading the matched JS is not consent; keeps the review pending and does not finalize.
If a map is supplied, validates it against the recorded JS, the used position and the supplied project before continuing; does not ask the user to certify correctness.
If the user accepts the limitation, records the scope and reply, keeps the generated location, and does not present a text match as an original location.
